# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the EMA ribbon contracts to low volatility (ribbon width < 0.3*ATR(14) for ≥3 consecutive 5-min bars), a break above the highest EMA (EMA_34) with expanding volume signals a volatility-expansion move. This edge exists because low-volume contractions often precede explosive moves, and the quantified ribbon width filter avoids false breakouts during equilibrium/chop.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** When ribbon width (EMA_34 - EMA_8) < 0.3*ATR(14) for at least 3 consecutive 5-minute bars, and the close crosses above EMA_34 with volume > 1.5*average_volume(20), go long at the close of the breakout bar.  
**Exit:** Chart-stop at the lowest EMA of the ribbon (EMA_8), TP1 at 1.5R (risk from entry to chart-stop), runner trailed 20% off HWM after TP1.
